anchor: Which low-level spell could drop a small cluster of foes into a deep nap, but not tireless creatures that never need rest?
Which low-level spell lasts a minute, reaches 60 feet, and can leave foes knocked cold after failing two tries?
Which young scaled winged creature that can breathe underwater also unleashes a crackling electric line of breath?
What scaled flying foe with a 60-foot fly speed pushed me 30 feet back with a gust and left me flat on the ground?
Which fighter perk at level 13 gives me a better shot at a foe after I miss it with a swing?
As a sorcerer, could I burn an unused spell slot for more resource points, and later spend those points to make a slot again as a quick move?
Which sorcerer ability lets me conjure a spell slot no higher than fifth level, and that vanishes after a full night's rest?
Which wearable jewelry lets me peer through walls for a minute, but risks tiring me if I use it again before resting?
What wearable gear lets me see through a foot of stone or three feet of wood, but a thin lead sheet stops it?
Which d100 result from a hand-held rod on a roll of 65 to 68 sends a loose object within 120 feet into another dimension?
Which spell takes 10 minutes and can make a region up to a mile square look and feel like a swamp or cliff for 10 days?
Which ten-day landscape trick lets sharp-eyed creatures see past it, and won't hide anyone standing in the area?
Which tiny, nearly defenseless crawling pest with one hit point has a tail stinger that adds toxic harm to its jab?
What tiny crawler with a mind barely above nothing can sense things within 10 feet without eyes?
Which glass-like item can snare anyone other than me who sees their own image within 30 feet of it, except mechanical beings?
What can I use to snatch a foe into a foggy pocket where they stop aging, if I stand within 5 feet and speak a word?
Which deceptive vial looks, smells, and tastes like a restorative draught but hides a toxic brew under trickery?
What harm do I take right away from gulping a tainted brew, and what hour-long sickness must I resist with a DC 13 roll?
Which second-level spell lets me pick up on any reasoning creature within 30 feet, unless stone or lead blocks it?
If I dig deeper into a talker's mind, how can that creature shut me out by making a knowledge check against my spell's strength?
Which huge chaotic-good flyer can tunnel underground and exhale a cone that knocks foes out cold?
Which winged monster can flip a failed roll to resist into success three times a day, four times while in its nest?
Which rare drink makes me shrug off all harm for a minute, and looks like molten metal?
Which enchanted armament adds a plus to hit and damage, growing from plus one at uncommon to plus three at very rare?
Which sixth-level ritual ward blocks teleporting and portal travel in a huge area and hurts chosen creature types that step inside?
Which warding effect can be bypassed by speaking a phrase I choose, and becomes permanent if I recast it daily for 30 days?
Which top-tier feat for characters level 19 and up lets me turn a missed swing into a hit, once until my next turn?
Which feat raises one of my core stats by 1, with a ceiling of 30, and requires a level of 19 or more?
Which enchanted pole can add an electric jolt to a melee hit, or make a deafening boom that can leave a struck foe dazed?
Which enchanted pole can fire a 120-foot electric bolt for 9d6 damage, with a dexterity roll to halve it?
Which frog-like creature can gulp down a medium-sized foe it has held, then dissolve it slowly, leaving it trapped?
Which large, water-dwelling creature can leap 20 feet from a standstill and grip a medium-sized foe in its bite?
Which strange, blob-like horror makes creatures within 20 feet roll a d8 each turn to decide whether they wander, freeze, or attack?
What creature cannot be knocked flat and absorbs a slain foe into its body with its bite?
Which bard cantrip lets me hurl a taunt at a foe within 60 feet, dealing mental harm and making its next swing weaker?
Which bard spell gets another die of harm at character levels 5, 11, and 17, and needs only spoken words to cast?
Which 2-pound kit lets me chart a route with a DC 10 check, or pinpoint my spot by reading the night sky at DC 15?
Which outer garment gives me an edge on rolls against magical effects while I wear it?
Which very rare blade can hover on its own, fly up to 30 feet and strike a foe near it, using my own to-hit roll?
After a floating blade strikes four times on its own, how does it come back, and when does it stop floating?
Which lawful-good heavenly being returns to life with full health in its home realm if killed somewhere else?
Which winged holy creature can bring the dead back to life once a day and has an edge on rolls against incoming spells?
Which second-level spell lets me touch an ally and pick a core stat, giving that ally an edge on checks for up to an hour?
When casting a second-level touch spell for ally checks, how many extra allies can I include for every slot level I go above?
Which rare body covering adds 1 to my defense whenever I'm wearing it?
Which piece of gear can take on another outfit's look with a quick action, yet keeps its real heft until I change it back?
Which reanimated corpse-king returns in 24 hours after destruction, but only if its tiny heart survives?
What ancient wrapped-body monster is weak to flames yet shrugs off life-draining harm and venom, and sees true forms up to 60 feet?
Which fighter ability gives me one additional move on my turn, not counting spellcasting, and refreshes after a brief or full rest?
Once I reach level 17, how many times can I use my extra-move power before resting, and can I use it twice in one turn?
Which second-level spell lets me spot creatures hiding from sight for an hour?
What spell lets me peer into the spectral borderland between worlds, where things look like faint wisps?
What fees would an otherworldly servant ask for a job lasting minutes, hours, or up to ten days?
If I can't agree a price with an otherworldly helper, what happens, and will one refuse a clearly deadly job?
Which fourth-level conjured barrier of flames can take the shape of a 60-foot straight line or a ring, dealing 5d8 damage?
What hazard can I make that hurts creatures on one selected face within 10 feet, and anything standing inside?
Which stick-shaped item points at the nearest hidden door or snare within 60 feet and regains a few charges every dawn?
Which one-shot projectile deals extra force damage to a creature type, then becomes ordinary after hitting?
On a d100 roll, which creature category is 91 to 00 for a projectile that does extra force harm?
Which small chaotic-neutral creature can swap places with an ally within 5 feet to take a blow aimed at it?
Which small creature with a bow reaching 80 feet can take a quick move on its turn to dodge out of melee or hide?
Which class gets a d8 per level and takes strength and dexterity saves, relying on dexterity and wisdom?
Which class picks two skills from tumbling, sneaking, lore, and similar options, and can use lightweight martial weapons?
At what level can a woodland tracker keep their focus on a marked quarry even while being struck?
Which tiny reptile-like critter can scurry across ceilings without making a check and nips for only 1 point of harm?
Which tiny creature with only 2 hit points climbs at 20 feet and sees in pitch darkness out to 30 feet?
Which class uses a six-sided hit die and a mind-based ability score, with saves tied to mind and insight?
What class can start with either two daggers, a spellbook, and a robe, or just 55 gold?
Which top-tier mind-affecting spell instantly ends a creature with 100 or fewer hit points, and otherwise hurts it for 12d12 mental harm?
What ninth-level spell targets one visible creature within 60 feet and needs only speech to cast?
Which first-level ritual lets me touch a gadget to learn its powers, whether it needs bonding, and how many charges it holds?
What low-level ritual reveals which ongoing magic is affecting a creature I touch during a one-minute casting?
